newsHighlights.title: One day to go: 9th Silk Road cultural expo

newsHighlights.title: Xi calls for better protection, coordination to beautify Yellow River

newsHighlights.title: Phantom Blade Zero makes a heroic debut

quote.quote: Live as if you were to die tomorrow. Learn as if you were to live forever.
quote.author: Mahatma Gandhi
quote.translation: 生活，如同明天就会离世；学习，如同生命没有尽头。
quote.explation: 这句话强调两种态度的结合：对生活要全情投入、珍惜当下，对学习要持之以恒、永不满足。成长正来自于每天坚持学习一点点，日积月累便成就终身的智慧。

pattern.pattern: devote one's life / oneself / one's time to + 名词或动名词（把……奉献给……）
pattern.example: Chang Shuhong devoted his life to protecting the Mogao Caves and their priceless art.
pattern.translation: 常书鸿把毕生奉献给了莫高窟及其无价艺术的保护事业。
pattern.usage: 注意 to 是介词，后面接名词或动名词（doing），不能接动词原形。同类表达还有 be devoted to doing、devote oneself to a cause。可用于描述学习目标：She devotes two hours a day to reading English news.

grammar.title: 过去分词作状语（Past Participle as Adverbial）
grammar.explation: 当句子的主语与分词之间是被动关系时，可用“过去分词 + 逗号”放在句首作状语，表示原因、时间、条件或补充说明，相当于一个省略的状语从句（如 Because he was known as…）。使用时，分词的逻辑主语必须与主句主语一致。
examples: Known as the “Guardian of Dunhuang”, Chang Shuhong devoted his life to protecting the Mogao Caves.（被誉为“敦煌守护者”，常书鸿把毕生献给了莫高窟。）
Built to speed the rollout of C-V2X technology, the draft standard is now open for public comment.（为加快车联网技术推广而制定的草案现已公开征求意见。）

pronunciation.tips: 重音在第一个音节 HE-；/h/ 要送气，/e/ 类似“诶”；中间的元音是短音 /ɪ/，不要读成“ai”；词尾是 /ɪdʒ/，与 judge、language 的结尾相同，舌尖抵住上颚再放开，声带振动。
examples: Conservators work hard to keep Dunhuang's heritage alive.
Cultural heritage is a bridge between the past and the future.

reading.title: Guardian of Dunhuang: A Life Devoted to Learning
reading.content:
Known as the “Guardian of Dunhuang”, Chang Shuhong devoted his life to protecting the Mogao Caves and their priceless art. Born in 1904, he studied painting in France, but a glimpse of Dunhuang's murals in a Paris bookshop changed his path. He returned to China and settled in the desert, where he spent decades copying frescoes, cataloguing treasures and training young conservators.

Today a new generation carries on his mission. The 9th Silk Road International Cultural Expo opens in Dunhuang this week, bringing together scholars, artists and students from across the world. For them, heritage is not only something to admire — it is something to study and pass on.

Chang's story shows that growth often begins with one decision: to keep learning, even when the road is long and lonely. Patience and devotion, he proved, can turn a fragile cave into a lasting school for the world.
reading.translation:
被誉为“敦煌守护者”的常书鸿，把毕生都献给了莫高窟及其无价艺术的保护。他1904年出生，曾在法国学习绘画，但在巴黎一家书店里瞥见的敦煌壁画改变了他的命运。他回到中国，扎根大漠，数十年如一日地临摹壁画、整理珍宝、培养年轻的文物修复师。

今天，新一代人正延续着他的使命。第九届丝绸之路（敦煌）国际文化博览会本周开幕，来自世界各地的学者、艺术家和学生齐聚一堂。对他们而言，文化遗产不仅是用来欣赏的，更是要学习并传承下去的。

常书鸿的故事告诉我们：成长往往始于一个决定——即使道路漫长而孤独，也要坚持学习。他用一生证明，耐心与热爱可以把一座脆弱的洞窟变成一所属于全世界的永恒学堂。
reading.sourceNote: 本文基于 ChinaDaily《One day to go: 9th Silk Road cultural expo》中关于常书鸿与莫高窟保护的报道改写，用于英语学习目的。
